pendingActions.title: Command Board
pendingActions.superseded: This request was superseded by a newer request. Removing it from the panel only removes its reference from this browser; the request and its history remain saved.
pendingActions.outcomeUnverified: The execution outcome is not confirmed yet.
pendingActions.satisfiedByOther: Fulfilled by another execution of the same request.
pendingActions.verificationDelayed: No confirmed outcome yet. The request will update when connectivity returns; do not execute it again.
pendingActions.loadedOutcomeUnverified: The requested build is loaded; the execution outcome could not be verified. Review the request status before retrying.
pendingActions.errorPreviewIdentity: The server candidate identity could not be verified. Nothing was restarted.
pendingActions.errorCandidateNotAwaiting: The queued candidate is not the one awaiting activation; nothing to load, no restart ran.
pendingActions.errorGateFailed: The safety gate refused the action; check the server log.
pendingActions.errorSensitiveCandidate: This build contains sensitive server changes and cannot use the ordinary restart path. It requires the reviewed release activation process.
pendingActions.errorLoadedArtifactUnavailable: The loaded server artifact does not match the preview ledger. Nothing was restarted; wait for the build watcher to reconcile it, then try again.
pendingActions.errorStalePreviewLedger: The preview ledger is older than the server build on disk. Nothing was restarted; wait for the build watcher to reconcile it, then try again.
pendingActions.errorUnknownCandidate: The server build lineage could not be verified. Nothing was restarted; install the reviewed release instead.
pendingActions.errorOidControlFailed: Candidate activation did not complete. Nothing was restarted. Do not click repeatedly; wait until the activation action is corrected, then run it once.
pendingActions.errorInFlight: Another action is already in progress, please wait.
pendingActions.errorNotClaimable: This action cannot be executed right now.

degraded.title: Server is running degraded

reasons.manual_recovery_required: Automatic recovery after an update did not complete; an operator must act before any new update.
reasons.source_update_maintenance: The maintenance gate is closed during a source update; service is limited until it reopens.
reasons.maintenance_state_unavailable: The maintenance journal could not be read; the state is treated as unhealthy by default.
reasons.source_state_unreconciled: The server reopened on the previous version, but the source tree still sits at the update target. Service works, but no new update can start until the source rollback is completed.
reasons.unknown: The server reported an unhealthy state for a reason this build does not recognise.
